titel: 50(b) - Johannes Brahms pt. 15b "Tokens of Friendship" a classical music podcast

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Johannes Brahms navigates friendships, the Fourth Symphony, and a great musical rivalry.
kurzfassung: Johannes Brahms deals with intense personal relationships, public reactions to his Fourth Symphony, and bitter musical rivalries in Vienna during the 1880s. He maintains a complex romance with young vocalist Hermine Spies while facing severe critique from close associates like Elisabeth Herzogenberg. Despite professional tensions and the politicization of music around figures like Anton Bruckner, Brahms ultimately reconciles with old friends through his art.
stichpunkte: Brahms develops a close and flirtatious friendship with young vocalist Hermine Spies in Vienna.
Brahms's Fourth Symphony faces initial skepticism and harsh reviews from close confidantes like Elisabeth Herzogenberg and his inner circle.
Anton Bruckner becomes an unwitting figurehead for conservative Wagnerians, sparking intense rivalry and political polarization in Vienna's musical scene.
Brahms accidentally alienates conductor Hans von Bülow by arranging a premature performance of his Fourth Symphony in Frankfurt.
Brahms spends productive summers in Thun, Switzerland, composing major chamber works including violin and cello sonatas.
Clara Schumann struggles with aging, family tragedies, and the painful return and burning of her letters with Brahms.
Brahms finally reconciles with longtime friend Joseph Joachim by composing the Double Concerto for violin and cello.

kapitel.titel: The Complex Legacy of Anton Bruckner
The War of the Romantics and Viennese Politics
The Premiere and Reception of the Fourth Symphony
The Frankfurt Incident with Hans von Bülow
Productive Summers in Thun and New Masterpieces
Clara Schumann's Letters and the Reconciliation with Joachim

clips.hook: Brahms was not quite Hermann's type.
clips.text: Despite their mutual affection, the narrator explains why a romantic future between Brahms and Hermine Spies was unrealistic given their differing ages, habits, and life paths.

clips.hook: A single cymbal stroke expressed more intellect than all of Brahms.
clips.text: Hugo Wolf wrote harsh and hysterical attacks against Brahms, claiming that a single percussion note in a work by Liszt held far more emotion than Brahms's entire symphonic output.
Brahms's friends were utterly perplexed by his decision to use an ancient chaconne form for the finale of his new symphony.

clips.hook: She called it the Reconciliation Concerto.
clips.text: Upon hearing about Brahms's new double concerto written for Joseph Joachim, Clara Schumann immediately recognized its profound significance in healing their broken friendship.

beschreibung:
Brahms pt. 15b: we detail the course of the Brahms-Joachim relationship as they return to something like their former friendly relations and see how is other friendships and partnerships evolve, disolve, change and mature as we reach the year 1887.
Works heard in this episode in order (all by Brahms):
Tafellied op. 93b
Der Tod, das ist die kühle Nacht op. 96 no. 1
Wir wandelten op. 96 no. 2
Nachtigall op. 97 no. 1 arr. for viola and piano by...me (viola)
Symphony no. 4 in E minor, mvt. 1 Allegro non troppo
Sonata for Violin and Piano in A major, op. 100, Allegro amabile
Allegretto grazioso

Double Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Orchestra op. 102, mvt. 3 Vivace non troppo
